kept.heading: PARTICIPATION IN BLACK FRIDAY-CYBER MONDAY SHOPPING EXPECTED TO HIT 10-YEAR HIGH (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Deloitte reports that 87% of consumers plan to shop during BFCM this year, with average spending flat at $624. Gen Z leads with 94% planning to participate and $752 in expected spending, up 23% year over year. Social media and GenAI use are linked to higher spending, with shoppers using both expecting to spend 61% more than those using neither. Meanwhile, 72% are delaying some purchases in anticipation of better deals.

kept.heading: AI CITATIONS TO SOCIAL MEDIA & UGC GREW 52% ON GOOGLE'S AI PLATFORMS, FELL 44% ON CHATGPT (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Citations to 18 UGC domains grew 52% across Google's AI platforms from January to August, but fell 44% on ChatGPT. YouTube led AI Overviews with 45% of tracked citations, while Reddit dominated ChatGPT at 52%. 17 of 18 sites gained citations on AI Overviews, while 12 lost citations on ChatGPT. TikTok saw the strongest growth across both. Despite low AI referral traffic of just 0.14%, UGC can shape brand visibility in AI answers. Citation patterns vary by category, making it important to identify which sources AI platforms reference most in your market.

kept.heading: HOW TO MAKE HIGH-QUALITY AI ADS (10 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI ads start with a product selling point and a customer pain point. Build a short story around one feature that solves a real problem, then test the hardest shot before generating the rest. AI reels often use a recognizable situation, an unusual opening frame, and a single product-focused payoff, usually within 15-30 seconds. Control the output by specifying shot sizes and color grading in consistent language. Generate short clips, make pacing and text adjustments in the edit, and change one prompt variable at a time.

kept.heading: THE B2B DEMAND GEN CHECKLIST (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: B2B companies can capture more existing buyer demand by improving how they handle high-intent leads. Route every demo and contact request to the right sales rep with instant booking or a response within 30 minutes. Track speed-to-lead as a KPI. Install ad pixels for retargeting and conversion tracking. Identify high-intent search and AI queries such as competitor comparisons and pricing. Target these through SEO, AEO, and paid search while organic rankings build.

kept.heading: TEST YOUR ECOMMERCE SITE FOR AI ACCESS (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Ecommerce sites can test whether AI crawlers can access and read their content using 3 checks. A free tool from a former Google employee tests whether AI bots are blocked by robots.txt or server settings. Asking ChatGPT to find a sentence hidden in collapsible content can reveal whether it retrieves JavaScript-rendered text. Chrome Reading Mode offers another check by stripping away navigation and pop-ups to show whether key content such as product titles, descriptions, pricing, and reviews can be extracted cleanly.

kept.heading: NEW HUBSPOT DATA REVEALS HOW MENTIONS AND CITATIONS RELATE ON THE AI ENGINE LEVEL (9 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Model releases now swing AI visibility the way algorithm updates once swung SEO. After an update to ChatGPT on August 6, cited URLs per prompt rose 51% and domain-specific searches rose 45x. Gemini's 3.7 Flash release cut citations per prompt 27% the same week it launched. Perplexity went the other way, doubling cited URLs per answer to about 18 while referral traffic fell 14%. Sources shifted too, with ChatGPT citing competitor sites more and forums and videos far less.

kept.heading: CAN WE DESIGN EMOTIONAL LOYALTY? (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: An emotional loyalty map treats loyalty as a series of moments, each with a specific emotion to design for. For every moment, from opening the app to a service failure, it compares what the member feels now with what they should feel and picks an action to close that gap. A new member opening the app may feel confused, so showing clear progress toward the next reward leaves them informed and motivated. After a service failure, the goal is reassurance, which comes from a fast fix and a reply that recognizes their membership.
